reason: It looks lovely, but $49 to $59 a month plus the drive and gas is a lot for me when I can wait for a Groupon or a free trial day. I would rather go to the library story time or set up my own Montessori shelf at home for free.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, so a monthly membership only pays off if I go several times a week, and I won't. Plus it's not even open yet.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial day or a Groupon for a few drop-ins, or a cheap punch-card option with no monthly commitment, so I could test whether it's worth the drive.
